source.attribution: K. K. Luke and May L. Y. Wong; Hong Kong Cantonese Corpus (HKCanCor), original corpus transcriptions, hosted by Francis Bond.
source.citation: K. K. Luke and May L. Y. Wong (2015), The Hong Kong Cantonese Corpus: Design and Uses, Journal of Chinese Linguistics Monograph Series 25, 312–333.
source.source_admission: Reuse the frozen reader unchanged. Keep raw Han, valid complete numeric reading, one character per syllable; punctuation, non-Han, unsupported annotation/reading and alignment mismatch end segments. Never join across holes, utterances or speakers. NFC fingerprints for dedup only; no text rewrites.

count_policy.frequency_unit: One count per actual retained training segment occurrence, including repeated occurrences within training. No type dedup, source weights, generated words, BOS/EOS or trigram counts.
exclusions: Keep old500/old93/cycle1 exact-target and substring overlaps in primary training: they are exposed development, never heldout. Report both overlap kinds rather than deleting core conversational grammar.

Remove train segments equal to any full segment in development or reserved transcript groups. Remove development segments equal to reserved full segments. Membership is computed from all admitted source segments before exclusion.
Remove any segment containing an opaque protected target at a supplied length (all 4+), using only UTF8 SHA256 equality; never open or export protected fixture text or matched contexts.
count_policy.strict_diagnostic: Also remove every old500/old93/cycle1 target substring of any length, reproducing the feasibility 72,905-character training view; optional paired model uses the same fitted vocabulary to isolate count differences.
count_policy.protected_opaque_exclusion: Length/SHA256-only exclusion; no protected target text, readings, hashes, matching source coordinates or contexts are published in this record.

primary.kind: Conversational occurrence bigram blend over expanded written-type lexical conditional

fixed_probability_contract: P1(c)=(lexUni(c)+0.1)/(sum(lexUni)+0.1*(unionVocabularySize+1)); unknown characters map to one UNK bucket.
Plex(c|p)=(lexBi(p,c)+10*P1(c))/(lexOut(p)+10). At p=None lexical bi/out are zero, so Plex=P1.
P(c|p)=(trainBi(p,c)+10*Plex(c|p))/(trainOut(p)+10). At p=None train bi/out are zero, so P=P1 unchanged relative to expanded-vocabulary lexical P1.
Future per-character cost=min(16,-ln(P)); weight0.25 retained for a later separately authorized fixed comparison. No scoring/reranking in this builder.

exposure.statement: All58 files/all49 groups were represented by exposed old500 first_occurrence records. Transcript partitions are disjoint for model fitting, not untouched accuracy data. Old500/old93/cycle1 are exposed development; overlap is reported, never described as heldout.

old500.interpretation: Exposed-development overlap only; no heldout claim and substring overlap is retained in primary training.

old93.interpretation: Exposed-development overlap only; no heldout claim and substring overlap is retained in primary training.

cycle1.interpretation: Exposed-development overlap only; no heldout claim and substring overlap is retained in primary training.

exposure.qualification: All49 groups/all58 transcripts already appeared in exposed old500 records. New group-disjoint fitting is not clean held-out data; old500/old93/cycle1 overlap is explicitly exposed development.

independent_count_audit.method: Independent raw annotation parsing, source/partition/exclusion reconstruction, binary decoding and occurrence-counter comparison. Builder/reader/model code was not imported or executed.

sparse_runtime.scope: Numeric probabilities, one UNK, immutable sparse storage and per-load byte/hash verification only; no sentence scoring, candidate query or latency acceptance.

notices.combined_adaptation_policy: Research-only local combined adaptation under CC-BY-SA-4.0 policy, preserving HKCanCor/Rime CC-BY-4.0 and words.hk public-domain notices; no production enable or shipping.
notices.historical_use_notice: Existing evaluation-only locks/notices are unchanged. A separate derived-model change notice records this new local fitting purpose; it does not rewrite historical evaluation claims.

limitations: No corpus-model quality, held-out likelihood, decoder acceptance, personalized learning, native UI or shipping result is established.
Protected fixture labels and corpus matching contexts are not disclosed. No training-source text or model binary is published by this JSON inventory.
